name: game-whiteout
description: Frosthold: Last Ember - an original frozen-survival city-builder / idle browser game inspired by (not based on) the genre: fuel a central Furnace with wood and coal to hold back the cold, gather food/wood/coal/iron through idle resource buildings, climb a Furnace-gated building tree, train troops, and repel escalating Frozen Horde waves. Built with Phaser 3.
